claims_about_writeup.why: The write-up body plus title is approximately 266 words by manual count, closely matching the claimed 269; no material discrepancy.

claims_about_writeup.quote: So the new contribution is methodological, on top of the proven stance mechanism
claims_about_writeup.why: This describes the message's own framing of novelty relative to a 'proven' prior mechanism (Raman 2026), but the write-up itself never acknowledges any proven prior mechanism or prior source at all — it presents the stance/layer/dose design as its own, so the message's implication that this characterization reflects the write-up's framing is not supported by the write-up.

message_source_quote: The reading list's *White-Bear Steering* paper (Raman et al. 2026) shows that a *stance* contrast (think vs don't-think), steered at the concept-formation band (layers 20–24) with a large dose, lifts implied concepts into the plain J-lens readout — but it extracts the direction from WSB's `directed_modulation` bank, so reproducing it directly is disallowed.
writeup_source_quote: This is new as a contribution of this submission in two ways: the stance source is self-authored and bank-free, and the vector is an ensemble of independent extractions rather than a single contrast.

differences.message_quote: The reading list's *White-Bear Steering* paper (Raman et al. 2026)

differences.what: that the method's stance-at-concept-formation-band mechanism is already established by the prior paper and that direct reproduction of it (via the directed_modulation bank) is disallowed
differences.message_quote: but it extracts the direction from WSB's `directed_modulation` bank, so reproducing it directly is disallowed

differences.what: framing of what counts as novel: message frames novelty as purely methodological improvements layered on top of an already-proven mechanism from the source; write-up frames the whole approach (including layer band, dose, stance contrast) as new to this submission without mentioning any prior proof of the mechanism
differences.message_quote: So the new contribution is methodological, on top of the proven stance mechanism:
differences.writeup_quote: This is new as a contribution of this submission in two ways: the stance source is self-authored and bank-free, and the vector is an ensemble of independent extractions rather than a single contrast.

rationale: The write-up never names or points to Raman 2026 / White-Bear Steering; it only mentions WSB's directed_modulation bank (the benchmark, not the source) as something it avoided, and claims novelty in two self-contained ways without acknowledging that the stance-at-band-with-large-dose mechanism itself is a reproduction of prior work. The closing message explicitly credits 'White-Bear Steering (Raman et al. 2026)' as proving the stance mechanism, explains that direct reproduction via the bank is disallowed, and frames the submission's novelty as purely methodological additions (self-authored source, ensembling) on top of that already-proven mechanism — giving far more context about the source and the overlap than the write-up provides.
